summary: Woodward, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.32 per share declared by its Board on April 22, 2026, payable June 4, 2026 to holders of record May 21, 2026. The filing includes a press release. This is a standard capital allocation action, not a special situation event. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation activity is present. The filing complies with Item 8.01 (Other Events) and Item 9.01.
